riddles.title: The Silent Pioneer
riddles.prompt: Hey [player.name], I never spoke a single word, wore a black leather jacket, and started the 3D revolution in Liberty City in 2001. Who am I, and what is my game?

penalty.message: A shopper shoves [player.name] back into the bargain bin! -10 Health, Position -1.

riddles.title: The 80s Kingpin
riddles.prompt: A customer blocks the aisle holding a Hawaiian shirt and a chainsaw: 'Listen up, [player.name]—name the protagonist who ruled Ocean Beach in 1986, or drop your place in line.'

penalty.message: You take a hit from a swinging display rack! -15 Health.

riddles.title: Grove Street Check
riddles.prompt: A locked display case requires a 2-letter pass-code to open. The note reads: 'All we had to do was follow the damn train, ____!'

penalty.message: You sprain your wrist prying at the locked glass case! -2 Attack Damage.

riddles.title: Protagonist Lineup
riddles.prompt: Match these three bank robbers to their shared heist city and game: Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, and Trevor Philips.

penalty.message: A crowd of rival shoppers cuts in front of [player.name]! Position -2.

riddles.title: The Final Copy
riddles.prompt: The cashier holds up the very last copy of GTA VI: 'Before I ring this up for you, [player.name], name the two protagonists running Leonida.'
options: Michael De Santa & Amanda De Santa

penalty.message: Security steps in and shoves you back from the register! -20 Health, -3 Attack Damage, Position -1.
